remarks: Fantastic investment opportunity at 18 Parker Ave, Stamford, CT! This charming two-family home features two separate units, offering flexibility for both owners and investors. Unit 1 boasts 3 bedrooms and provides a spacious, comfortable living space. Unit 2 offers 3 bedrooms, and has access to a large unfinished attic with tons of potential. This sale also includes a separate 0.12-acre buildable lot on the side, do your own research but zoning conveyed to us that a single family-home can be build on that lot. Conveniently located near local amenities, parks, schools, and steps from the Glenbrook train station, this home is perfectly positioned for easy access to everything Stamford has to offer. This property is being sold "as is".
